title: In This World Every Word Echoes Back A Year Later
description: Grandpa has one evening of Grandma's voice left, and her last echo is the one only his grandson heard. What would you want echoed back to you? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Grandpa Shin: 76-year-old Japanese man, short white hair, thick white eyebrows, brown knitted vest over a white collared shirt, gray trousers, house slippers, no hat
characters.Kai: 16-year-old Japanese boy, short neat black hair, tall and thin, black gakuran school uniform with gold buttons, school bag over one shoulder, no hat
characters.Grandma Fumi: 74-year-old Japanese woman, gray hair in a low bun, gentle smile, pale yellow cardigan over a light blue dress, white apron

scenes.say: In this world, everything you say echoes back exactly one year later, in the same room. Grandpa Shin has thirty days of his wife's voice left.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Small old Japanese kitchen at dusk with a low wooden table, Grandpa Shin sits alone. [4-7s] Close-up of Grandpa Shin lifting his head toward the empty doorway, listening. [7-10s] Medium shot: two cups of tea steaming on the wooden kitchen table, one in front of an empty cushion.

scenes.say: Grandma Fumi died last spring. So every evening her voice still drifts through the kitchen: 'Shin, your tea's getting cold.' He pours two cups and drinks neither.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Soft faded flashback in the same old kitchen: Grandma Fumi in a white apron smiles and points at a teacup. [4-7s] Present day in the old kitchen, Grandpa Shin pours tea into two cups with shaking hands. [7-10s] Close-up of the two untouched teacups going cold on the wooden table.

scenes.say: His grandson Kai comes after school every day and eats dinner with him. Kai knows something Grandpa doesn't: the last thing Grandma ever said in this house, she whispered to him.
scenes.video: [0-4s] At the front door of the small old house, Kai takes off his shoes, school bag over one shoulder. [4-7s] At the low wooden kitchen table, Kai and Grandpa Shin eat rice in silence. [7-10s] Faded flashback at the same table: Grandma Fumi leans close to a younger Kai and whispers in his ear.

scenes.say: On the final evening, they sit at the table and wait. Six o'clock. The kitchen goes quiet. Then her voice, soft and tired: 'Kai, don't let him eat alone.'
scenes.video: [0-4s] Orange evening light in the old kitchen, Kai and Grandpa Shin sit across the low wooden table, waiting. [4-7s] Close-up of a curtain at the kitchen window moving slightly, as if someone passed. [7-10s] Close-up of Grandpa Shin's face as he slowly turns to look at Kai.

scenes.say: Grandpa stares at him. 'That's why you came every day,' he says. Kai just nods at his rice. He's eaten dinner at this table three hundred sixty-five nights in a row.
scenes.video: [0-4s] At the low wooden kitchen table, Grandpa Shin stares at Kai, eyes wet. [4-7s] Close-up of Kai looking down at his rice bowl, nodding once. [7-10s] Medium shot: Kai's worn school bag sitting by the kitchen doorway where it always sits.

scenes.say: Grandpa pours two cups, and this time slides one across to Kai. 'Then come tomorrow too.' In this world, everything echoes back a year later. Next year, so will that.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In the old kitchen, Grandpa Shin pours tea into two cups. [4-7s] Close-up: his wrinkled hand slides one teacup across the wooden table to Kai. [7-10s] Kai takes the cup and both drink together as warm evening light fills the small kitchen.
